In addition, rapid technological changes and digital disruption, including the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence and data-driven platforms by competitors, customers, suppliers, and other market participants, as well as the development and introduction of new aircraft components, advanced replacement parts, and digitally enabled or AI-optimized maintenance solutions, may alter competitive dynamics and customer expectations.
